title: Page 5
lines: 「爷爷，我回来了！」
折好最后一件衣裳的赵元广抬起头，含笑地看向与三年前截然不同的野风。
这三年来，他们辗转去过许多地方，他们上山种过果树，也去海边晒过盐，挖过煤也跑过商，来到这西苑国后，她便从跑商商人身边的小厮，变成了在酒楼里跑堂兼牵马小厮，而他，则是被酒楼所聘的账房。
以往那个曾被他背在背上的小女孩，如今已学会种田骑马、进山打猎、跑堂算账，每天在客栈里招呼商客往来，不但眼界开了、懂得世故和圆融了，她身上官家少女的影子，更是早就淡得已再瞧不见。
可是，光只是这样，还远远不够。
「明日咱们就离开这儿。」赵元广收回目光，边说边把折好的衣裳放进准备好的包袱里。
「这么快？」原本满心兴高采烈的野风一愣，没想到他们好不容易才安定下来几个月，转眼又要再次上路。
「这儿你能学的都已学会，没有再留下的必要了。」天下很广，世界更是辽阔，眼下她已能把日子过得如鱼得水，那便也够了，她可不能永远只窝在这儿当个小厮。
「接下来要上哪？」野风没什么精神地问，一想到又要奔波劳顿，她就无比怀念这阵子安稳的日子。
赵元广在她顶上轻敲一记，并顺手取走她手中的那只银袋。
「你该问的是接下来你要学些什么。」再让她待下去，她逢客便溜须拍马的功夫可就愈来愈厉害了，她是打算一辈子当个靠着打赏过日子的小厮吗？
「我该学什么？」她才几岁而已，就已经学了拉拉杂杂一大箩筐了，虽不是样样都专精，可也够用了，偏偏他就是认为艺多不压身，老要她多学点别的，也害得他们老像浮萍似的，一国又一国的漂过来漂过去。
「医药。」赵元广整理好包袱，将趴在桌上的她拉起来坐正，「你外祖可是个名医，你娘也有这方面的天分，而你嘛……」野风搔着发，「我就是打发时间背过几本医书而已。」当年她在大牢中，漫漫长夜里，除了挖洞外也就只剩背书这娱乐了，谁让她逃出外祖家时怀里就只塞了几本医书而已？
「几本？」
「十来本。」除了外祖家的外，还有赵元广买的。
「都背齐全了？」老早就看出异状的赵元广，不动声色地再问。
「……滚瓜烂熟。」她皱眉地想了想，发现那些所背过的内容竟像是烙印在她的脑海中似的，半样没忘，字字句句都没落下。
他抬手在她的额上再敲一记，「因此你更是不该埋没这天分。」
「好吧……」她泄气地垂下两肩，「我这就去收拾行李。」
「不问问祖父为何要你学那么多吗？」赵元广在她转身欲走时，好笑地看着她认命的模样。
野风缓缓抬起头，一双黑白分明的大眼中，没了方才的沮丧，有的却是对生活的期待与盼望。
「为了让我活下去。」打从他们离开沙屿国起，脚下每踏出的一步，每个曾留下的脚印，都是为了一个心愿。
只是为了活下去。
这三字看来似是简单，或可说是再寻常不过，可没经历过魂祸的人不会知道，当性命不被当成性命，甚至连身为人的资格都被剥夺，沦为成只是用来许愿用的材料时，这三个字，就成了屠刀下的艰辛。
生命中所有的希望，全都似被敲碎的骨头散了一地，无法合拢无法重聚，每日每日看着那些牢中的同伴不断被拉出去用来许愿时，自尊早已是落入泥地里的春花，没人认为它打紧，也无人有心神将它拾起。
她和许多时时徘徊在死生之间的人一样，在那等不可知是否还会有来日的困境中生存着，都只是想要多喘一口气，盼着下一顿饭能在汤水中捞到些许肉末，工作时能少挨顿打，身上能有一件避寒的冬衣……他人不会知道，单单只是要活下去，就已让她耗尽所有的精神与气力。
「是为了让你在任何地方、任何环境下都能活下去。」赵元广握着她的手腕将她拉来面前，指尖徐徐抚过她面上留下的伤疤，「株不屈的劲草，永远不匍匐向地。」
「嗯。」野风撒娇地将他的掌心摆至脑袋顶上，并用头蹭蹭他的掌心。
他笑笑地用力搓了她几把，见她开心地咧着笑容，他再以指挠了挠她的下巴，她便像只猫儿般享受地眯了眯眼，舒服得就差没打起呼噜。
「早点长大，知道吗？」
「知道。」
桌上不安定的烛光，将祖孙俩依偎的身影拉得很长很长，再摇曳成融融的温暖，哪怕窗外可能风刀雨剑，又或明日荆棘遍地。
接下来的数年，他们走过大江南北，走过各国与众城，穿过高山漠地，曾经为祸整片大陆的魂祸，在各国主事者的极力反扑下，亦渐渐宣告平息，诸国国内也再次恢复秩序，重新燃起生机。
而野风他们在流浪了十年后，由野风带着年迈且病重的赵元广回到他的故乡，伴他度过生命最终的数月，并以孙女的身分为他送终。
这些年，身在云取宫中的叶慈，并不是毫无所为，也非将双手置于身后，任由下一任神宫新主流落在外，从不派人去寻，相反的，他是只心焦的锅上蚁，无时不刻都想打听到新宫主的下落，以及能早日离开神宫这座牢笼，好亲自去迎他搁在心头上已多年的宫主。
可他不能。
打从叶慈接下神官一职，正式与少宫主司徒霜分庭抗礼起，整座神宫，就成了一座活生生的监牢。
由司徒霜所许出的魂役云过，乃千年前遭祸惨死的阵法大家，在魂主司徒霜的令下，云过不惜以耗费自身相级中阶的生命力为代价，在整座云取宫外围设下炼魂大阵，将云取宫上千宫众困于阵中，也将叶慈寻找新宫主的步伐死死困在宫中。
于是这些年来，叶慈一面在不断派人到宫外打听新宫主的下落，也拼命在闭关提升自身的实力，以求能在破阵后，亲自上极山道观好去求得那么一份消息。
而就在此夜
闭关已有数月的叶慈，刚一出关，就带人直闯设在宫外的大阵，闻讯赶来的云过，起先不过认为，叶慈又再次像以往一般行那徒劳之功，妄以为单凭他相级初阶的实力就能破阵。可就在云过欲前往大阵之处，打算再一次浇熄叶慈的期望时，蓦然间，原本天际上犹在闪烁的星子，似被黑暮给掩了去，斜斜缀在西方的弯月也失去了芳踪。
下一刻，极度刺耳的嚣音震天骤响，云过警觉地抬首，却乍见那九百九十九道被他缚在大阵中以支持阵眼的冤魂，已化为一道道白光呼啸上天。他登时心下一紧，连忙将身形化为一道黑雾冲向正在破阵的叶慈。
正倾尽全力破阵的叶慈，身后似长了眼般，在那阵黑雾欲袭向他时，他微偏过身子，及时避开由黑雾化为人形的云过所击来的全力一掌，同时抬起右手化掌为爪，快狠准地探入云过的左胸处，生生抓握住云过那一颗早在千年前就已不再跳跃的心。
云过怔怔地低首看着他没入胸口的手，瞠大的眼瞳中尽是不可思议。
「这不可能……」这小子……在数月前不过就是个相级初阶而已，要想杀他这相级中阶，最起码也得是同阶或是高阶，可这短短数月，叶慈他怎么就……叶慈看也不看他一眼，兀自发力握碎了掌中所擒着的那颗心。
content_en:
"Grandpa, I'm back!"
Zhao Yuanguang, who had folded the last piece of clothing, raised his head and looked at the wild wind that was completely different from three years ago with a smile.
In the past three years, they have been to many places. They have gone to the mountains to plant fruit trees, to the seaside to dry salt, to dig coal, and to work as a merchant. After arriving in Xiyuan Kingdom, she changed from a servant beside a merchant to a waiter and horse boy in a restaurant, and he was hired as a bookkeeper in the restaurant.
The little girl who used to be carried on his back has now learned how to farm and ride horses, go hunting in the mountains, settle accounts, and greet businessmen in the inn every day. Not only has her horizons broadened, she has learned to be sophisticated and harmonious, but the shadow of an official girl in her has long since faded away.
However, this alone is not enough.
"Let's leave here tomorrow." Zhao Yuanguang withdrew his gaze and said as he put the folded clothes into the prepared baggage.
"So soon?" Yefeng, who was originally full of joy, was stunned. He didn't expect that they had finally settled down for a few months and would be on the road again in the blink of an eye.
"You have learned everything you can learn here, there is no need to stay anymore." The world is very wide, and the world is even more vast. For now, she can live her life like a fish in water, and that is enough. She cannot just stay here as a servant forever.
"Where are you going next?" Yefeng asked without energy. When she thought about having to travel and work hard again, she missed the stable days very much.
Zhao Yuanguang tapped her on the top and took the silver bag in her hand.
"What you should ask is what you want to learn next." If she is allowed to stay any longer, her ability to flatter every guest will become more and more powerful. Does she plan to live as a servant who relies on rewards for the rest of her life?
"What should I learn?" She was only a few years old, and she had already learned a lot of Lala Zaza. Although she was not expert in everything, it was enough. However, he just thought that having too many skills was not enough, and always wanted her to learn other things, which made them drift from country to country like duckweeds.
"Medicine." Zhao Yuanguang packed up the baggage and pulled her up to sit upright on the table. "Your grandfather was a famous doctor, and your mother was also talented in this field, and you..." Yefeng scratched his hair, "I just passed the time and memorized a few medical books." When she was in prison, during the long nights, the only entertainment besides digging holes was endorsement. Who told her that when she escaped from her grandfather's house, she only stuffed a few medical books in her arms?
"How many copies?"
"More than ten copies." In addition to the ones from my grandfather's family, there were also ones bought by Zhao Yuanguang.
"Have you memorized everything?" Zhao Yuanguang, who had noticed something strange a long time ago, asked again calmly.
"...It's very familiar." She frowned and thought about it, and found that the contents she had memorized seemed to be imprinted in her mind, and she had not forgotten even a single word.
He raised his hand and hit her on the forehead again, "That's why you shouldn't bury this talent."
"Okay..." She dropped her shoulders in frustration, "I'm going to pack my luggage right now."
"Why don't you ask your grandfather why he wants you to learn so much?" Zhao Yuanguang looked at her resigned look in amusement when she turned around to leave.
Yefeng slowly raised his head, his big black and white eyes showed no frustration just now, but there were expectations and hope for life.
"To keep me alive." From the moment they left Shayu Country, every step they took and every footprint they left were all for a wish.
Just to survive.
These three words may seem simple, or even ordinary, but those who have never experienced soul disaster will not know that when life is not regarded as life, and even the qualifications of being a human being are deprived of it, and are reduced to just materials used to make wishes, these three words become the hardships of the butcher's knife.
All the hopes in life are like broken bones scattered on the ground, unable to be put back together or reunited. Every day when watching the companions in prison being pulled out to make wishes, self-esteem has long been like a spring flower that has fallen into the mud. No one thinks it is important, and no one has the heart to pick it up.
Like many people who are constantly wandering between life and death, she lives in the predicament of not knowing whether there will be a future. She just wants to breathe more, looking forward to getting some minced meat in the soup for the next meal, to get less beatings at work, and to have a winter coat to protect herself from the cold... Others will not know that just to survive, she has exhausted all her energy and strength.
"It is so that you can survive in any place and in any environment." Zhao Yuanguang held her wrist and pulled her in front of him. His fingertips slowly touched the scars on her face. "An unyielding grass will never prostrate to the ground."
"Yes." Yefeng coquettishly placed his palm on top of his head and rubbed his head against his palm.
He smiled and rubbed her hard a few times. Seeing her grinning happily, he scratched her chin with his fingers. She squinted her eyes in enjoyment like a cat, and she was so comfortable that she almost snored.
"Grow up early, you know?"
"I know."
The unstable candlelight on the table stretched the snuggling figure of the grandfather and grandson very long, and then swayed into a warm warmth, even if there might be wind and rain outside the window, or there might be thorns everywhere tomorrow.
In the following years, they traveled north and south of the Yangtze River, through various countries and cities, and through mountains and deserts. The soul disaster that once brought disaster to the entire continent gradually subsided due to the vigorous counterattacks of the leaders of each country. Order was restored in the countries and vitality was rekindled.
After Yefeng and the others wandered for ten years, Yefeng took the elderly and seriously ill Zhao Yuanguang back to his hometown, spending the last few months of his life with him, and dying for him as his granddaughter.
Chapter 2(1)
In these years, Ye Ci, who was in Yuntori Palace, did not do nothing, nor did he put his hands behind his back and let the next new master of the shrine fall away without sending anyone to find him. On the contrary, he was an anxious ant in the pot, always wanting to know the whereabouts of the new palace master and to leave the prison of the shrine as soon as possible so that he could personally meet the palace master who had been in his heart for many years.
But he can't.
Ever since Ye Ci took over the position of priest and officially fought against the Young Palace Master Situ Shuang, the entire palace has become a living prison.
The soul service Yun Guo was promised by Situ Shuang was a master of the formation who died tragically a thousand years ago. Under the orders of the soul master Situ Shuang, Yun Guo set up a soul refining formation outside the entire Yuntei Palace at the expense of his own mid-level life force, trapping thousands of people in the Yuntei Palace in the formation, and also trapped Ye Ci's search for the new palace master in the palace.
So over the years, while Ye Ci has been sending people outside the palace to inquire about the whereabouts of the new palace master, he has also been working hard to improve his own strength in seclusion, hoping that after breaking the formation, he can go to Jishan Taoist Temple in person to get such information.
And just this night
Ye Ci, who had been in seclusion for several months, just came out of seclusion and led his people to break into the large formation outside the palace. Yun Guo, who came after hearing the news, at first thought that Ye Ci was once again doing the same futile work as before, thinking that he could break the formation with his junior level strength alone. But just when Yun Guo was about to go to the formation, intending to extinguish Ye Ci's expectations again, suddenly, the stars that were still twinkling in the sky seemed to be covered by the darkness, and the crescent moon slanting in the west also lost its fragrance.
The next moment, an extremely harsh roar rang out. Yun Guo raised his head alertly, only to see that the nine hundred and ninety-nine innocent souls that he had bound in the formation to support the formation's eyes had turned into streaks of white light and roared into the sky. His heart suddenly tightened, and he quickly turned into a black mist and rushed towards Ye Ci who was breaking the formation.
Ye Ci, who was trying his best to break through the formation, seemed to have eyes behind him. When the black mist was about to hit him, he turned slightly and avoided the full palm of Yun Guo, who was transformed into a human form by the black mist. At the same time, he raised his right hand and turned it into a claw. He quickly and accurately penetrated Yun Guo's left chest and grasped Yun Guo's heart that had stopped beating thousands of years ago.
Yun Guo stared down at his hand that was buried in his chest, his wide eyes full of disbelief.
"This is impossible..." This kid... was just a junior phase leveler a few months ago. If you want to kill him, an intermediate phase leveler, you have to be at least the same level or a higher level. But in just a few months, how could Ye Ci... Ye Ci didn't even look at him, and spontaneously broke the heart in his palm.
